preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 1000.
The number of vertices n in each test case must be between 2 and 200000.

preconditions.expression: len(a) == n and all(1 <= a[i] <= n for i in range(n)) and len(set(a)) == n and a[0] == 1
preconditions.description: The visiting order array a must have length n, contain unique integers from 1 to n, and start with 1.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum height of the tree for each test case.
